title: Beyond Appearance Shifts: Task-Semantic Action Calibration for VLA Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.23650v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance in embodied manipulation, but still lack a clear mechanism to balance behavioral stability with task-semantic sensitivity. We identify two complementary failure modes. Under task-preserving changes, where task semantics remain unchanged but scene appearance varies (e.g., style, illumination, clutter, or paraphrasing), policies often exhibit unnecessary action drift. Conversely, under semantic-breaking changes, where key task semantics such as the target object or constraint are altered, policies frequently fail to produce sufficiently distinct behaviors and instead follow the original trajectory. To address this gap, we propose BAS-VLA, a task-semantic action calibration framework built on top of a frozen base VLA. translated_title: 超越外观变化：面向VLA模型的任务语义动作校准
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在具身操作任务中已取得优异表现，但仍缺乏一种明确的机制来平衡行为稳定性与任务语义敏感性。我们识别出两种互补的失败模式：在任务保持型变化下（即任务语义不变，但场景外观发生变化，例如风格、光照、杂乱程度或指令改写），策略往往表现出不必要的动作漂移；相反，在语义破坏型变化下（即关键任务语义如目标物体或约束被改变），策略常常无法产生足够不同的行为，而是继续沿原轨迹执行。为填补这一空白，我们提出BAS-VLA，一个构建在冻结基础VLA之上的任务语义动作校准框架。BAS-VLA采用以破坏为中心的校准核心作为默认路径，并引入一个选择性的、由证据门控的保持辅助模块，该模块仅在……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出BAS-VLA任务语义动作校准框架，通过以语义破坏为中心的校准核心与证据门控的保持辅助模块，使VLA模型在场景外观变化时保持动作稳定，而在任务语义改变时产生显著不同的行为。
en_tdlr: BAS-VLA is a task-semantic action calibration framework built on a frozen base VLA that eliminates unnecessary action drift under appearance-only changes while producing sufficiently distinct behaviors when key task semantics are altered.
